request.style: English, male baritone solo with backing choir, electric guitar, bass, drums, organ, anthemic rock mood, 110 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Sons of Judah born in the land
Er and Onan and Shelah stand
Five sons in all from Perez line
Hezron and Hamul in design

[Chorus]
Shattered before the Lord and his army
The Cushites fell and none were left alive
Help us Lord for we rely on you
In your name we fight the multitude

[Verse]
Mesha the firstborn father of Ziph
Mareshah the father of Hebron
Keilah Akzib and Mareshah towns
Nine villages in Judah's bounds

[Chorus]
Shattered before the Lord and his army
The Cushites fell and none were left alive
Help us Lord for we rely on you
In your name we fight the multitude

[Verse]
Asa went out to meet the foe
In Valley of Zephathah low
He called upon the Lord his God
Powerless against the mighty load

[Chorus]
Shattered before the Lord and his army
The Cushites fell and none were left alive
Help us Lord for we rely on you
In your name we fight the multitude

[Outro]
Carried off a very great amount of plunder
Before the Lord the enemy is under
